flavor.phonemic_palette: Hobgoblin (Kazhur, clipped-command regression): orc-guttural but ORDERED - hard geminated stops (-kk/-tt), sharp clipped finals -rok/-thar/-tark, minimal growl-drawl; barked, drill-like. The least-rotted beastman tongue.

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore §4.2): Lawful venerates the 12 Lawful powers and names the 13 as demons; Chaotic venerates the 13 and names the 12 as tyrant-gods; Neutral venerates this culture's ancestral saints, invoking the great gods only situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Hobgoblin — xenophobic clan confederation of the hills; survival.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Hobgoblin are a Chaotic beastman race; aggression 0.85, organized as clan confederation. Their tongue is a regressed form (see name_bank 'hobgoblin'). Stripped record per gdd-culture-catalog §5.3.
